description: This file defines a template class TimerType within the Thunder::Core namespace, which implements a timer mechanism with scheduling, triggering, revoking, and processing functionalities. It also includes a nested class TimedInfo for managing scheduled information and a class WatchDogType for thread-based watchdog timers. The file includes other core modules like Module, Sync, Thread, and Time, indicating its role in core timing and thread management within the project.

classes.name: TimerType
classes.description: A template class providing timer scheduling, triggering, and management functionalities, including nested classes TimedInfo and TimeWorker.

classes.name: WatchDogType
classes.description: A thread-based watchdog timer class that can be armed, reset, and configured with a handler.

methods.name: Schedule
methods.description: Schedules a timer event at a specific time with associated content.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Clears all pending timer events and blocks the timer thread.

methods.name: HasEntry
methods.description: Checks if a specific content entry is scheduled.

methods.name: Trigger
methods.description: Triggers a timer event immediately with specified content.

methods.name: Revoke
methods.description: Removes a scheduled event associated with specific content.

methods.name: NextTrigger
methods.description: Returns the time of the next scheduled trigger.

methods.name: Pending
methods.description: Returns the number of pending scheduled events.

methods.name: ThreadId
methods.description: Returns the thread ID of the timer thread.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Internal method to process scheduled events, called by the timer thread.

methods.name: ScheduleEntry
methods.description: Inserts a new timed info entry into the schedule, maintaining order.
